Planned configuration for createAct365Contact1 (uipath.connector.uipath-act-act365.create-contact). Run the following command once an Act! 365 connection exists to configure this node:

uip maestro flow node configure MultiselectTest.flow createAct365Contact1 \
  --detail '{"connectionId":"<YOUR_CONNECTION_ID>","folderKey":"<YOUR_FOLDER_KEY>","method":"POST","endpoint":"/CuratedContacts","bodyParameters":{"firstName":"Jane","lastName":"Doe","emailAddress":"jane.doe@example.com","company":"Acme Corp","groups":["group-id-1","group-id-2","group-id-3"]}}' \
  --output json

The 'groups' field (requestFields name 'groups[*]') is the multi-select Groups array.
Strip the '[*]' suffix from the wire key and pass an array of group IDs.
Group IDs can be resolved with:
  uip is resources run list uipath-act-act365 Groups --connection-id <YOUR_CONNECTION_ID> --output json
